appearance.rationale: The archive record prints this exact Schøyen MS number. Last of the five held back on 13 September; its cluster is now decided same_object and this is the canonical record.

claims.notes: The archive covers JBA 1-64, the bowls edited in Shaked, Ford and Bhayro, Aramaic Bowl Spells vol. 1 (2013). Presence of photographs only; no image is deposited and none is rights-cleared.
claims.value_text: Photographed in the Virtual Magic Bowl Archive as JBA 5 (MS 1927/64); 20 images held in the archive.
